concept.title: Worked examples and scenarios
concept.abstract: This chapter presents practical DITA conversion scenarios that demonstrate how to analyze source content, classify topics into appropriate DITA types, identify reusable content, structure maps, and implement conditional publishing. Through real-world examples such as software user guides, API documentation, and multi-audience content delivery, it illustrates decision-making frameworks and best practices for transforming complex documents into scalable, reusable, and audience-specific DITA architectures.
